name: Los Haitises National Park
story: Los Haitises National Park is located on the remote northeast coast of the Dominican Republic and was established in 1976. It features a limestone karst plateau with conical hills, sinkholes, caverns, and a large area of mangrove forest.
matters: The park contains a great diversity of mammals and birds, including rare species endemic to the island. It holds the largest population in the world of the endemic Ridgway's hawk.
